name: dig
description: Source-specific research tools and methods with a native retained-evidence library.

interface.longDescription: Research web documents, repositories, papers, social platforms, commerce and prediction markets with source-specific methods. Retain original responses, save grounded reports and inspect the evidence in a native library. The initiating conversation chooses sources and composes only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Research this question with Dig and keep the original evidence.
